name: The Eternal Sponge
description: A sacred sponge that has absorbed the essence of countless galaxies worth of spills

interactions.examine: The Eternal Sponge looks like an ordinary yellow sponge, but when you focus on it, you can see entire galaxies swirling within its porous structure. It pulses with a gentle golden light and feels warm to the touch, as if it's alive. Legends say it was used by the First Janitors to clean up after the Big Bang.
interactions.take: You carefully pick up the Eternal Sponge. It feels impossibly light yet somehow infinitely heavy with significance. As your fingers touch it, you feel a brief connection to every spill ever cleaned, every mess ever managed. It's profound and slightly damp.
interactions.use: You squeeze the Eternal Sponge experimentally. A single drop of golden liquid falls out - it appears to be the condensed essence of pure cleanliness. The sponge immediately absorbs it back. Using this for mundane cleaning would be like using a supernova to light a candle.
